**TK 95 31 CHIRAL LAGRANGIANS FOR BARYONS COUPLED TO MASSIVE SPIN–1 FIELDS ⋆**

*B. Borasoy a 1 , Ulf-G. Meißner a 2*

26 pp, 40 sections.

**Abstract.** We analyze the eﬀective low–energy ﬁeld theory of Goldstone b osons and baryons chirally coupled to massive spin–1 ﬁelds. We use the electro magnetic baryon form factors to demonstrate the formal equivalence between the v ector and the tensor ﬁeld formulation for the spin–1 ﬁelds. We also discuss the origin of the so–called Weinberg term in pion–nucleon scattering and the role of ρ–meson exchange. Chirally coupled vector mesons do not give rise to this two–pion nucleon seagu ll interaction but rather to higher order corrections. Some problems of the for mal equivalence arising in higher orders and related to loops are touched upon.
